purpose: Text-readable authoring policy, not a visual capability certificate. Native ranges and existing approved motions alone never establish an axis effect.
limitations: No independent tail-joint parameter is currently documented; do not invent a tail capability from its drawable name.
Palm/back-of-hand turns and large shoulder lifts require appropriate artwork and independent contact/occlusion review.
The seated sleeves have typing/rock controls; standing arm controls cannot be assumed to lift seated hands.
Current posture transition chooses two painted bodies and aligns collar/neck geometry; it is not a complete anatomical stand/sit rig.
This policy does not approve new expressions, parameter combinations, motion revisions, or model changes.
Historical axis reports below have no complete model-input binding. They remain references, not current measured capabilities.

current_writers: CubismCanvas::paintGL Native write and head/body ownership
posture_constraints: Short reactions may own this head channel plus the explicitly allowed silhouette channels; preserve standing/seated support and held props.

current_writers: CubismCanvas::paintGL Native write and posture grounding
posture_constraints: Short reactions may own BodyAngleX and BodyAngleZ; BodyAngleY is not allowed and Breath is reserved for the idle base.
Full posture/held-prop/arm support remains owned by the activity; allowed silhouette axes do not authorize support changes.
Gaze does not prove eye art, occlusion, or contact correctness at combined head extremes.

current_writers: ParameterMotion::advance expression blend then procedural blink
posture_constraints: Blink multiplies the blended authored eye expression; do not implement a competing blink writer.

current_writers: CubismCanvas::paintGL binary mouth gating and drawable opacity patch
posture_constraints: Mouth selectors and opening controls are coupled by the current renderer; direct Native writes bypass this contract.

current_writers: ParameterMotion::advance state curves and seated arm hold
posture_constraints: Standing arm rig and seated sleeve/hand art are different controls.
Arm channels are reserved from short reactions; do not move held props with a short-reaction overlay.

current_writers: ParameterMotion::advance grass clip or interaction phase
posture_constraints: Use the grass player enter/hold/respond/timeout/release contract.
Keep palm grip and visibility in agreement; a grip value is not a measured grass-root contact distance.
The spring player owns final flex values; do not add a second final-value writer.
Grass root must remain fixed at the palm; geometric contact is separately measured.
Short reactions may own HairFront/HairBack according to the extracted whitelist.
Authored curves and Native physics share this channel; effective output depends on physics order and freeze mode.
Do not independently animate posture/material drivers during a short face reaction.
Ground and collar alignment are runtime constraints, not unrestricted vertical travel.
Valid only with the matching seated torso/sleeve/hand art; standalone prop movement is unmeasured.
Short reactions may own ShiftX; ShiftY remains reserved and policy-blocked.
Window position is separate from model displacement; the current grounded renderer cancels model Y travel.
Do not author this parameter until a model-bound probe and the current validator allow it.

historical_inert_axis_report.scope: The asset validator records earlier zero-pixel eyebrow probes and blocks the grounded Y axis. This is an enforcement source, not a fresh visual measurement.

historical_posture_geometry_report.scope: Recorded posture/material/collar/neck verification on 2026-10-03; does not establish arbitrary axis combinations, visible effect of each individual axis, or new visual approval.

ParamAngleX.purpose: Head horizontal angle; use measured small reactions before exploring combined extremes.

ParamAngleZ.purpose: Head tilt and short-reaction directional tilt.

ParamBodyAngleX.purpose: Body horizontal pose angle; support and silhouette are separate from head gaze.

posture_constraints: Not allowed in the current short-reaction whitelist.

ParamEyeLOpen.purpose: Left eyelid expression, multiplied by procedural blink.

ParamEyeROpen.purpose: Right eyelid expression, multiplied by procedural blink.

ParamEyeSmile.purpose: Smile-eye material/shape driver; review with eye-open controls.

ParamEyeBallX.purpose: Horizontal gaze; grass hover and head pat may own its offset.

ParamEyeBallForm.purpose: Declared jelly-eye axis; eye-jelly physics disabled in current metadata and no current visible-effect probe.
prohibited_reasons: Current authoring policy excludes the unverified jelly-eye axis.

ParamBrowLY.purpose: Declared left eyebrow Y; earlier validator reports no drawn/keyed eyebrow effect.
posture_constraints: The reaction whitelist contains this name, but the asset validator still prohibits authoring it.

ParamBrowRY.purpose: Declared right eyebrow Y; earlier validator reports no drawn/keyed eyebrow effect.
posture_constraints: The reaction whitelist contains this name, but the asset validator still prohibits authoring it.

ParamMouthForm.purpose: Opening shape when selected mouth art is visible.
posture_constraints: A closed-mouth probe alone cannot establish this shape axis's effect.

ParamMouthOpenY.purpose: Mouth opening driver subject to Native mouth selector gating.
posture_constraints: Gape forces fully open MY; closed selectors force MY=0 to suppress a ghost grin.

ParamSmileOpen.purpose: Select resting omega or open-smile art; do not use it as a third gape state.

ParamMouthGape.purpose: Neutral bite-mouth selector; renderer quantizes it and patches drawable opacity.

resolution_contract.prohibited_operation: Do not clamp MotionClip/ParameterMotion logical values to MOC min=1; this would make every pose appear gape-on.

posture_constraints: Logical 0/1 selector is a runtime contract; Native range alone does not establish correct art visibility.

ParamCheek.purpose: Cheek puff/accent for chewing or short expressions.

ParamBreath.purpose: Idle breathing base shared across states.

ParamArmLA.purpose: Standing left shoulder/arm pose; not a seated typing-hand lift control.

ParamArmRA.purpose: Standing right shoulder/arm pose, including grass hand.

ParamWristRA.purpose: Right wrist planar angle; does not establish palm/back-of-hand turning.

ParamGrassReach.purpose: Authored right-hand/grass forward perspective; not unrestricted 3D reach.

ParamGrassSwing.purpose: Grass stem bending from authored target and spring lag.

ParamGrassTipBend.purpose: Grass tip bending relative to the stem with lag and rebound.

ParamSitPose.purpose: Standing knee-fold driver resolved together with ground/material/collar constraints.

resolution_contract.grounding: CubismCanvas resolves floor/collar/neck after Native model update; this is not an unrestricted root-Y axis.

ParamLaptopVisible.purpose: Laptop lid/base visibility after seated support is established.

ParamBusyTypingL.purpose: Small left seated sleeve/hand typing deformation.

ParamBusyTypingR.purpose: Small right seated sleeve/hand typing deformation.

ParamShiftX.purpose: Model-relative horizontal shift inside the pet window; window movement is separate.

ParamShiftY.purpose: Declared model-relative vertical shift cancelled by current ground contract.
current_writers: CubismCanvas::paintGL ground resolution cancels vertical travel
